title: Juicy Brazilian Chicken Stew
description: This earthy and tender stew features a rich tomato sauce and is a low-calorie-friendly option for a cozy dinner, the chicken is brined before cooking to ensure it stays juicy.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together 1 cup of chicken broth, 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and 1 teaspoon of salt to create a brine, then add the chicken breast and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the brine and pat it dry with paper towels.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until it is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and make sure it is covered with the sauce.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
